name: Malo
notes: List 96 of Tryon & Hackman (1983) and Tryon (1994: 638-645), a Santa Cruz (Natügu) dialect; 97.1% cognate with Lwepe (Appendix 2, p. 646). Glottolog's Malo, a dialect of Natügu. Coordinates from Glottolog 5.4.

name: Lwepe
notes: List 97 of Tryon & Hackman (1983) and Tryon (1994: 638-645), 'S. Cruz L', a Santa Cruz dialect 97.1% cognate with Malo (p. 646). Glottolog has no code for it; it shares Natügu's. Coordinates are Natügu's (Ross et al. 2023: 626).
